text:
Noah Kim: Heads-up: Quill Systems (reseller) proposing special onboarding: 10-month prepaid $95,000 credits, 30% reseller discount on seats for first 4 months, and 18% rev-share on net revenue. They request net-45 invoicing and monthly payouts. Need finance + legal ok for one-off terms. @Jules Ortega @Priya Sen

Jules Ortega: Need COGS and margin test. Who on infra signed off on the $95k usage profile? Also confirm payment method (wire vs card) for exposure control.

Noah Kim: Payment by ACH. Infra (Marco) ran a run-rate sim: expected COGS ~ $21k over contract life. Recognition plan: defer $95k, recognize monthly over 10 months.

Marco Diaz: Confirmed COGS estimate based on hosted profile v2 (p50 tokens). Does not include professional services for integration. If integration is needed, cost could add $5-8k.

Priya Sen: Accounting notes: we will book Deferred Revenue (2100) and recognize to Product Revenue (4001). Need a payout reserve GL (5110) to hold rev-share liabilities until reconciliation. Also we need clarity whether rev-share is paid on gross or net (we prefer net after platform fees).

Noah Kim: Quill wants rev-share on net after transaction fees. They also asked if rev-share can be advanced in month 1; prefer not.

Jules Ortega: Guardrails: (1) cap rev-share payout at 45% of gross margin; (2) require proof of wire before provisioning; (3) require reseller to accept KYC + tax W-9/1099 info. If those OK, I can approve the discount + net-45.

Priya Sen: Treasury: exposure for net-45 prepaid under $100k is acceptable with reserve 28%. We'll set initial reserve at 28% of prepaid into GL 5110. Approving: 30% reseller discount (4 months), net-45 invoicing, monthly payouts, prepaid recognition monthly, rev-share reserve 28%. :white_check_mark:

Marco Diaz: Please note integration cost caveat in SOW. If PS required, chargeback to partner or deduct from prepaid per agreement.

Noah Kim: Great. Rana from Legal? (cc'd via follow-up) We'll attach SOW to BILL ticket. billing-bot, please create ticket for plan config and GL mapping. tag 'quill-reseller-v1'.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-4905: "Quill reseller onboarding - prepaid + rev-share". Tasks: create plan_id 'quill-reseller-v1', invoice template, map GL 5110 for reseller reserve. Link: https://redwood.internal/billing/BILL-4905. Next steps: legal addendum -> billing config -> KYC collection. ETA 2 business days.
